# Keenpix v0.3.2

Keenpix v0.3.2 turns the work merged since v0.3.1 into one immutable platform, package, and container release.

## Highlights

- The self-hosting guide now derives the checkout tag and all four GHCR image tags from the shipped Keenpix version instead of maintaining separate hard-coded copies.
- The copyable setup command generates the required application, authentication, and encryption secrets before Docker Compose starts.
- Comparison and migration content now connects evidence-led product evaluation to a measurable first-image activation path.
- The managed delivery edge runtime has clearer ownership and Cloudflare for SaaS deployment guidance.

## Platform

### `@keenpix/docs`

#### Fixes

- Kept the Git checkout and app, transform, worker, and docs images on the same immutable release tag.
- Added focused regression tests for stale or mismatched release tags and required secret generation.
- Preserved copyable desktop and mobile self-hosting instructions.

### `@keenpix/app`

#### Improvements

- Added the image CDN cost calculator, expanded comparison and migration surfaces, and connected comparison calls to action to the activation funnel.
- Adopted the native TanStack Start theme provider and enabled the React Compiler.

### `@keenpix/delivery-edge`

#### Maintenance

- Clarified the managed delivery edge runtime name and the single wildcard Worker route used with Cloudflare for SaaS.

### `@keenpix/transform-app`

#### Maintenance

- Ships with the unified v0.3.2 runtime and shared cache dependency versions.

### `@keenpix/worker`

#### Maintenance

- Ships with the unified v0.3.2 runtime and production Compose image set.

## Public packages

### `@keenpix/core`

#### Maintenance

- Publishes the framework contract on the unified v0.3.2 release line.

### `@keenpix/sdk`

#### Maintenance

- Publishes the management SDK on the unified v0.3.2 release line.

## Upgrade notes

- Upgrade Keenpix packages and all runtime images together to `0.3.2`.
- Pin production runtime images to `v0.3.2`; the production Compose defaults now use this immutable tag.
- Review the regenerated self-hosting command because it creates required secrets locally before the first Compose start.
- No database migration or delivery-edge route change is required solely for the self-hosting documentation fix.
